fields.title: NPC procurement record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope covering three record types from Papua New Guinea's National Procurement Commission (NPC) -- distinguished by 'record_type'. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). See CRAWLING_METHOD.md for why the field set differs by record_type.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: '(open tenders)' for tender_notice records, or the record_type ('disposals-notice'/'contracts-awarded') otherwise.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-tender-advertisement-html (open tenders), S1-wp-rest-list (list-only, fetchDetails off), S2-detail-html (list + detail page), or 'none' on an error record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (no open tenders currently, or a type genuinely returned zero rows) or blocked_or_transient (network/upstream issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

reference_number.title: Reference number
reference_number.description: tender_notice only -- NPC's own 'NPC/YYYY-NN' tender reference.

description.title: Description
description.description: tender_notice only -- the full free-text tender description/EOI text as published.

closing_date.title: Closing date
closing_date.description: tender_notice only -- free-text closing date/time as published (not normalized -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md).

post_id.title: Internal post ID
post_id.description: tender_notice only -- NPC's internal numeric ID for this card.

source_url.title: Source page URL
source_url.description: tender_notice only -- always the /tender-advertisement/ listing page (no individual permalink exists for this record type).

id.title: WordPress post ID
id.description: disposals-notice/contracts-awarded only -- NPC's internal numeric post ID.

link.title: Public URL
link.description: disposals-notice/contracts-awarded only -- the record's own detail page.

date.title: Publish date
date.description: disposals-notice/contracts-awarded only -- when NPC published this record.

fields.title: Labeled detail fields
fields.description: disposals-notice/contracts-awarded only, when fetchDetails is on -- every 'Label: value' field found on the record's detail page, kept verbatim as upstream authored it (e.g. 'Agency', 'Contract Value Inc GST (PGK Unless Specified)', 'Supplier Name'). Label text is free-form and varies by record, which is why it is not split into fixed columns.

pdf_url.title: PDF advert/document link
pdf_url.description: Direct link to the tender advert or notice PDF, when one is published. null for contracts-awarded (no PDF is published for awarded contracts).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for browsing tenders, disposals, and contracts together.
